observations: Street scale reads well enough to preserve the v004 horizontal frame.
Facade variation improved, but many buildings still share the same window/sign-band grammar.
Roofscape is too uniform and dominated by broad polished-deepslate rectangles.
City Hall is not distinctive enough relative to neighboring storefronts.
Historic north-end buildings need stronger upper-window/cornice identity.
Rear and alley elevations are too generic.
Street furniture is useful but should be less evenly procedural.
v005_actions: Explicit facade programs per primary footprint.
